title: Scriptura Research Agent Specification
description: A declarative agent specification. Normative source: BKB-AGENTS-001 section 4. NO AGENT EXECUTES AT M0. Capabilities are deny-by-default; output_layer may only ever be ai_hypothesis. An agent without human_review_points or limits cannot be approved.

purpose.description: The research question the agent serves.

status.description: Nothing runs unless approved. At M0 no specification may be approved for execution.

items.description: The grantable set only. Capabilities outside this set are NOT GRANTABLE by any specification, approval or configuration. See BKB-AGENTS-001 section 5.

scope.description: Enumerated and bounded. 'The whole corpus' is not a scope.

output_layer.description: Only ai_hypothesis is grantable. No other value may appear.

evidence_obligations.description: What the agent must produce for its output to be admissible. See BKB-AGENTS-001 section 6.

human_review_points.description: Where a human must intervene. An empty list means the specification cannot be approved.

failure_behaviour.description: Must be fail-closed. See BKB-AGENTS-001 section 11.
